months.note: Baseline — 7-month averages from the Isracard statements

tasks.text: Get your name on the מקיף in writing
tasks.d: 073-7801186, סיגל at זהר & נאמן. You qualify under the driver clause, but the policy is in your mother's name and you are the main driver. Confirm the ₪750 excess while you are on the phone.

tasks.text: Settle the car terms in writing
tasks.d: Who you owe, ₪54,000, whether any interest applies, and the ₪7,100/month schedule from December. Family money goes wrong precisely because nobody wrote it down.

tasks.text: Check your Poalim details in the אזור אישי
tasks.d: The מענק pays to whatever account is on file within 60 days of 30 September. A stale account number is the one way to delay ₪18,500.
₪7,100 to the car, ₪2,500 to אנליסט, ₪611 to a separate account for insurance. Pause the Blink contributions.
Last car payment clears 30 April. On 1 May raise אנליסט from ₪2,500 to ₪9,000 and restart the ₪600 to Blink — the same day.
Free from Bank of Israel. The ק.ל.ס loan is in your name — know how it is recorded, years before it matters for a mortgage.
Blink plus crypto, checked each quarter. Trim back rather than letting a winner run past the cap.

tasks.text: Decide what the פיקדון is for — then don't touch it
tasks.d: Studies or a deposit. Write the decision down. Restricted money gets spent badly precisely because it does not feel real.
